## Evaluation Criteria

When choosing an AI visibility tool, consider more than just cost. We've evaluated tools on **coverage breadth, data capture quality, prompt set customisation, reporting capabilities, team workflow features, pricing value and compliance** , **multi‑platform LLM monitoring** , **search‑engine tracking** , **prompt research tools** , **citation and source tracking** , **advanced sentiment analysis** and **share‑of‑voice metrics**. These criteria help ensure you’re not just tracking what AI says, but also how it discovers and summarises information about your brand.

## Detailed Overview of Key Alternatives

### SE Ranking AI Search Toolkit

SE Ranking’s AI Search Toolkit tracks how your brand appears in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other generative search surfaces. It shows trending prompts, identifies citation sources and even analyses how AI crawlers interact with your site. Because it integrates with SE Ranking’s wider SEO platform, you also get keyword research, rank tracking and on‑page analysis. It’s a strong choice if you already use SE Ranking or need a multi‑channel SEO suite.

### Rankability AI Analyzer

Rankability built its AI Analyzer for agencies. It monitors brand mentions across major AI platforms and provides white‑label reports, automated prompt scheduling and share‑of‑voice metrics. The platform exports data to CSV or Google Sheets and integrates with Looker Studio for client reporting. Its focus on agency workflows (project organisation, multi‑seat access) and competitive pricing make it attractive for consultants, though it requires regular engagement to realise its full value.

### GetMint

GetMint addresses a common complaint about Profound—it moves beyond monitoring to help you **act** on insights. It combines AI‑visibility tracking with a “RAG” content studio that analyses the sources currently winning for your target prompt and helps you draft content to fill gaps. The platform also offers a **sources explorer** to see which websites influence AI models, an **expertise library** where you can upload your own PDFs, a **brand alignment score** that audits how AI associates your brand values and a **sentiment heatmap** across models. On the €99/mo starter plan, GetMint covers ChatGPT, AI Overviews and Perplexity. The main drawbacks are that content generation consumes credits and prompt limits are lower than traditional keyword trackers.

### Hall AI

Hall AI is aimed at developers, technical SEOs and e‑commerce teams. It offers **agent analytics** that track which bots (like ChatGPT bots or Claude bots) crawl your site, their IP addresses and frequency. It also has a unique **shopping visibility** feature that monitors product‑level visibility in ChatGPT’s shopping interface. A **free “Lite” tier** allows testing with weekly updates and three AI engines. However, data retention is limited on lower tiers and the price jump to the Starter plan ($239/mo) is steep.

### AIclicks

AIclicks tracks mentions across six major LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, AI Overviews and Gemini) and provides real‑time dashboards, prompt‑level auditing, competitor comparison, citation analysis and content creation recommendations. The tool emphasises that ranking on Google is no longer enough; brands must show up inside AI answers. Its accessible pricing (from $79/mo) and actionable insights make it suitable for many marketing teams, though it doesn’t replace a full SEO suite.

### LLMrefs

LLMrefs positions itself as the most affordable AI visibility tool (around $79/mo). A review notes that it provides basic keyword‑level visibility and competitor citations across 11 LLMs but offers limited prompt‑level analysis and lacks sentiment tracking. Its simplified setup may benefit small teams new to AI visibility, but deeper insights require more advanced tools. The same review rates it 2/5 overall and points out that its LLM.txt generator and free tools lack proven value.

### Surfer AI Tracker

Surfer AI Tracker launched in July 2025 as an add‑on to the SurferSEO platform. It captures actual responses from ChatGPT (standard and search modes), Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, giving marketers a true picture of their AI search footprint. Key features include **prompt‑level insights** , **source transparency** (showing which pages were cited) and **weekly trend reports**. Pricing is sold in 25‑prompt blocks at $95 per month; larger bundles reduce the per‑prompt cost. Early adopters appreciate the holistic coverage and smooth integration with SurferSEO, though there’s limited historical data and costs can add up for high‑volume monitoring.

# Free llms.txt generator

Optimize how Gen AI and Language Models (LLMs) understand the content of your website with Decoding's new free tool, the LLMs.txt Generator, which allows you to add the most important content of your website and download a structured text file. 

The llms.txt file is a proposed web standard, not official or required, but might help LLMs process websites' content with more context.

**Default policy** Allow all LLM usage Disallow all LLM usage Custom (use rules below)

**Allow paths** (one per line)  


**Disallow paths** (one per line)  


**Crawl-Delay** (seconds, optional)

**Block specific AI crawlers (via dedicated sections)** OpenAI — GPTBot  
Google — Google-Extended  
Anthropic — ClaudeBot  
Perplexity — PerplexityBot  
Common Crawl — CCBot  
Amazon — Amazonbot  
Apple — Applebot-Extended  
ByteDance — Bytespider  
DataForSEO — DataForSeoBot

**Sitemaps** (full URLs, one per line)  


**Contact** (email or URL, optional)

**License (optional)** — a URL stating your usage terms

**Notes (comment only, optional)**  


Copy Download llms.txt Reset

**Generated llms.txt**  


## Instructions

Here’s how to use the **llms.txt Generator** on the page:

  1. **Pick a default policy**
     * **Allow all** : You’re fine with AI/LLM crawlers using your content.
     * **Disallow all** (default): You don’t want AI/LLM crawlers to use your content.
     * **Custom** : You’ll specify exactly which parts are allowed/disallowed below.
  2. **Set path rules (one per line)**
     * **Allow paths** : Enter folders or pages you want to allow (e.g., `/public`, `/press-kit`).
     * **Disallow paths** : Enter folders or pages you want to block (e.g., `/private`, `/drafts`, `/api/`).
     * Tips: 
       * Paths should start with a `/` (root-relative).
       * A trailing `/` usually means “this folder and everything inside it.”
  3. **(Optional) Set Crawl-Delay**  
Enter a number of seconds to slow compliant crawlers (e.g., `10`). Leave blank for no delay.
  4. **Choose specific AI crawlers to target**  
Tick any bots you want dedicated sections for (e.g., **GPTBot** , **Google-Extended** , **ClaudeBot** , **PerplexityBot**). 
     * If your **default policy** is **Disallow** , selected bots get `Disallow: /`.
     * If **Allow** , selected bots get `Allow: /`.
     * If **Custom** , they mirror your path rules.
  5. **(Optional) Add Sitemaps**  
Paste full URLs, one per line (e.g., `https://example.com/sitemap.xml`).
  6. **(Optional) Add Contact & License**
     * **Contact** : Email or URL where people can reach you.
     * **License** : A URL describing your content usage terms.
  7. **(Optional) Notes**  
Add any comments (they’ll appear as `#` comments at the top of the file).
  8. **Generate the file**  
The “Generated llms.txt” box updates automatically as you type.
  9. **Export your file**
     * **Copy** : Click **Copy** , then paste into a new file named `llms.txt`.
     * **Download** : Click **Download llms.txt** to save it directly.
  10. **Publish it on your site**
     * Upload `llms.txt` to the **root** of your site (the top level). 
       * Example: it should be reachable at `https://yourdomain.com/llms.txt`.
       * For a subdomain, use that host’s root (e.g., `https://blog.yourdomain.com/llms.txt`).
  11. **Verify it’s live**
     * Visit the URL in your browser to confirm it loads.
     * If you use a CDN or cache, purge/clear it.
  12. **(Recommended) Mirror key rules in robots.txt**  
Some crawlers mainly honor `robots.txt`. Consider adding matching user-agent blocks there (e.g., a `User-agent: GPTBot` section) so your intent is clear.



### Quick tips & gotchas

  * Keep paths simple (no wildcards needed).
  * If you choose **Disallow all** , but want some public areas open, list them in **Allow paths** (e.g., `/public`).
  * Don’t accidentally block your sitemap if you want crawlers to find it.
  * Adoption of `llms.txt` varies; pairing with `robots.txt` increases coverage.
  * You can return anytime, adjust settings, and re-download a fresh `llms.txt`.



## What is LLMs.txt?

llms.txt is a new proposed web standard, just like robots.txt, but designed for for AI consumption, so models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude can quickly summarize or generate content based on your website.

This file will help AI systems understand and give more context and to attribute correctly your content in LLM and Gen-AI search answers.

LLMs.txt is a concise, markdown-formatted, summary of your website's most important content, including internal links.

### Why is this file important?

LLMs and GenAI-powered search have a small window of context to handle the complexity of large websites, the llms.txt helps give quickly that context with the most important and relevant content.

### Can Google or other search engines use my LLMs.txt?

Currently, search engines don't use LLMs.txt. However, as AI integration grows, it's possible that search engines might leverage this LLMs.txt files in the future.

## What Is ChatGPT Visibility?

Every day millions of people ask ChatGPT and other AI assistants for product recommendations, comparisons and advice. Instead of ten blue links, these systems deliver a single synthesized answer. **ChatGPT visibility** measures how often and how accurately your brand is mentioned in those answers. It looks at:

  * **Brand mentions** – Does the model include your name or website?
  * **Citation links** – Are your pages cited, or does it link to a competitor?
  * **Answer position** – Is your brand mentioned first, last or not at all?
  * **Sentiment and framing** – Is the tone positive, neutral or negative?
  * **Entity clarity** – Does the model correctly understand your brand, or confuse you with someone else?



Understanding and improving these signals is critical because AI assistants are quickly becoming the first point of contact for buyers. Studies show that more than 40 % of younger shoppers use AI instead of traditional search engines for product research. When ChatGPT recommends a competitor, you lose potential customers even if you rank #1 in Google.

## Why You Need a Visibility Tracker

> _If you’re not mentioned in AI answers, you’re invisible when it matters most._

Generative AI models learn from publicly available content. They surface brands that have strong topical authority, high‑quality citations and clear entity signals. Without monitoring, you won’t know whether ChatGPT recommends your brand or misrepresents you. A dedicated visibility tracker helps you:

  * **See the bigger picture** – Discover where your brand appears (or doesn’t) in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI platforms.
  * **Spot inaccuracies and gaps** – Identify outdated descriptions or missing citations so you can address them quickly.
  * **Benchmark against competitors** – Compare how often you’re mentioned versus your peers and see which queries trigger competitor recommendations.
  * **Prioritize content and PR efforts** – Focus on topics and sources that influence AI models, strengthening your authority where it counts.
  * **Adapt to the AI search shift** – As AI assistants become the default interface for answers, proactive monitoring becomes an essential part of SEO and brand management.



## How does it work?

Our tool combines AI analysis with SEO best practices to give you actionable insights. Here’s what happens when you start a free audit:

  1. **Domain and entity analysis** – We analyse your website and extract key entities (products, features, topics) to understand what you’re known for.
  2. **Prompt generation** – Using Jobs‑to‑Be‑Done (JTBD) methodology, we generate relevant queries that real customers ask (e.g., “best CRM for small businesses”).
  3. **AI visibility check** – Our system queries ChatGPT and other models and records where your brand is mentioned, which pages are cited and how you’re positioned.
  4. **Score and metrics** – You’ll get a visibility score (0‑100) that combines citation rate, position and sentiment. We also show explicit citations (direct links) and implicit mentions (third‑party mentions that influence AI responses).
  5. **Actionable recommendations** – Beyond data, we provide a personalized checklist to improve your AI presence. This includes content gaps, PR opportunities and technical fixes like schema markup.



### Key Metrics We Deliver

  * **Citation rate:** Percentage of queries where your brand is mentioned.
  * **Explicit citations:** Number and quality of links to your pages in AI answers.
  * **Implicit mentions:** Brand references on external sites that feed into AI training.
  * **Visibility score:** Overall ranking of your presence versus competitors.
  * **Sentiment analysis:** How positively or negatively your brand is framed.

The problem? Traditional SEO tools are blind to AI search. Google Search Console won't tell you if ChatGPT recommends your competitor over you. Your rank tracker can't see which sources AI platforms cite when answering buyer questions.

That's where ChatGPT visibility trackers come in. I spent the last few weeks testing the top tools on the market. Some are excellent. Others are overpriced SEO add-ons with an AI sticker slapped on top. This guide cuts through the noise to show you what actually works.

## What is a ChatGPT visibility tracker?

A ChatGPT visibility tracker is a specialized tool that monitors how often, how accurately, and in what context your brand appears in AI-generated responses.

Unlike traditional SEO tools that focus on Google rankings, these tools track:

  * **Brand mentions:** Does ChatGPT name your brand when users ask about your category?
  * **Citation links:** Does it include direct links to your website?
  * **Answer position:** Are you the first recommendation or buried at the bottom?
  * **Sentiment and framing:** Is the tone positive, neutral, or negative?
  * **Entity clarity:** Does AI understand who you are, or confuse you with competitors?



Most tools now track across multiple LLMs, not just ChatGPT. The best ones monitor ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude simultaneously. Why? Because your customers use different AI assistants, and you need visibility across all of them.

There's also an important distinction between **explicit citations** (direct links to your domain in AI responses) and **implicit citations** (brand mentions from third-party publishers that AI references). Good trackers monitor both.

## How I evaluated these ChatGPT visibility tracker tools

Before diving into the list, here's how I tested each tool:

  * **Platform coverage:** Does it track ChatGPT only, or multiple LLMs?
  * **Data accuracy:** How reliably does it detect brand mentions and citations?
  * **Pricing transparency:** Are costs clear upfront, or hidden behind "contact sales"?
  * **Ease of use:** Can you get actionable insights without a PhD in data science?
  * **Unique features:** What makes this tool different from the other six?



I ran each tool against the same set of test queries to compare results. I also evaluated pricing, onboarding experience, and support responsiveness.

**A quick note on selection:** I focused on tools that deliver actionable insights, not just raw data. The best ChatGPT visibility tracker isn't the one with the most features, it's the one that tells you exactly what to do next.   * Lite: $29/mo (15 prompts, 1,000 audits)
  * Standard: $189/mo (100 prompts, 5,000 audits)
  * Premium: $489/mo (400 prompts, 10,000 audits)
  * 15% discount on annual billing



**Best for:** Marketers who want actionable optimization guidance and agencies looking for white-label reporting.

### 5\. [LLM Clicks](https://llmclicks.ai)

LLM Clicks takes a different approach to pricing: lifetime deals. Instead of monthly subscriptions, you can pay once and use the tool forever. For teams tired of recurring SaaS bills, this is appealing.

The [Starter lifetime deal](https://llmclicks.ai/pricing) costs $159 one-time and includes 300 AI visibility checks per month, 1 project, and 50 page audits. The Professional plan at $239 adds 10 projects and custom branding. The Agency plan at $399 includes 30 projects and 1,500 checks per month.

Feature-wise, LLM Clicks covers the standard bases: AI Visibility Tracker, Citation Analysis, Industry Benchmarks, and continuous monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, and Copilot. The "Voice of Search" feature measures share of voice against competitors.

One quirk: all plans include a 14-day free trial, which seems odd for a lifetime deal product. But it gives you a chance to test before committing to the one-time payment.

**Pros:**

  * Lifetime pricing option (no recurring fees)
  * 14-day free trial on all plans
  * Continuous monitoring capabilities
  * Competitor visibility analysis



**Cons:**

  * Less established brand (newer to market)
  * Monthly check limits can feel restrictive
  * No monthly subscription option if you prefer that



**Pricing:**

  * Starter: $159 one-time (300 checks/mo, 1 project)
  * Professional: $239 one-time (700 checks/mo, 10 projects)
  * Agency: $399 one-time (1,500 checks/mo, 30 projects)
  * Additional queries: $20 per 1,000



**Best for:** Teams who prefer lifetime pricing over monthly subscriptions and want continuous monitoring.

### 6\. [GoVISIBLE](https://govisible.ai)

GoVISIBLE approaches AI visibility through the lens of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It's built on the VISIBLE™ Framework, which includes 7 pillars of AI visibility covering everything from entity optimization to citation ecosystems.

The platform monitors ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot. But the real differentiator is the focus on entity clarity: ensuring AI understands who you are and doesn't confuse you with competitors.

[GEO Flex pricing](https://govisible.ai/pricing) starts at $69 per month per project. The unique twist is volume pricing: track 1 project for $69, or scale up to 10 projects at $49 each. This makes it cost-effective for agencies managing multiple clients.

Features include a GEO Dashboard with visibility scoring, Competitor Leaderboard, Sentiment and Share-of-Voice Insights, Prompt Intent Clusters, and Citation Graph analysis. Data refreshes daily.

**Pros:**

  * Comprehensive GEO framework (not just tracking)
  * Volume pricing benefits agencies
  * 5 AI engines monitored
  * Unlimited users on all plans
  * Entity clarity focus



**Cons:**

  * Per-project pricing can get expensive at scale
  * 50 prompts per month on base plan (lower than competitors)
  * Less intuitive for beginners



**Pricing:**

  * GEO Flex: $69/mo per project (volume discounts to $49/project)
  * GEO Enterprise: Custom (unlimited projects, dedicated CSM)
  * Extra prompts: $15 per package



**Best for:** Brands focused on entity clarity and comprehensive GEO framework implementation, plus agencies managing multiple client projects.

### 7\. [Wellows](https://wellows.com)

Wellows offers something no other tool on this list does: a completely free tier with no signup required. You can run a [ChatGPT visibility audit](https://wellows.com/tools/chatgpt-visibility-tracker/) right now, no credit card, no email, no commitment.

The free tool analyzes your domain, generates 40 intent-driven queries using the JTBD (Jobs-to-be-Done) framework, and checks where your brand appears across ChatGPT citations. You get metrics on citation rate, explicit citations, implicit citations, and position ranking.

Paid plans start at $37 per month per domain for the Lite plan, which includes 1 AI engine (ChatGPT), 40 prompts, and 2 content generations. The [Essential plan](https://wellows.com/pricing) at $97 adds Google AI Overviews tracking and increases limits. The Starter plan at $297 covers 5 engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews, AI Mode) with 400 prompts.

All paid plans include unlimited explicit and implicit opportunity tracking, unlimited outreach emails, daily monitoring, and Google Search Console integration. You also get strategic monthly calls (1-5 depending on plan), which is unique among these tools.

**Pros:**

  * Completely free tier (no signup)
  * 7-day free trial on paid plans
  * Strategic monthly calls included
  * Unlimited opportunity tracking
  * GSC integration on all plans



**Cons:**

  * Per-domain pricing (not per-account)
  * Lite plan limited to ChatGPT only
  * Less comprehensive reporting than premium tools



**Pricing:**

  * Free: 40 queries, no signup
  * Lite: $37/domain/mo (ChatGPT only, 40 prompts)
  * Essential: $97/domain/mo (2 engines, 100 prompts)
  * Starter: $297/domain/mo (5 engines, 400 prompts)
  * Pro: $497/domain/mo (5 engines, 1,000 prompts)



**Best for:** Small businesses and startups testing AI visibility tracking for the first time, and anyone who wants to run a quick free audit.

### 8\. [Semrush One](https://www.semrush.com)

Semrush is the 800-pound gorilla of SEO tools, and their AI Visibility Toolkit extends that platform into AI search monitoring. If you're already a Semrush customer, this is the obvious choice.

The toolkit includes several reports: Visibility Overview, Competitor Research, Brand Performance, and Narrative Drivers. You get an AI Visibility Score from 0-100, monthly audience metrics, mentions tracking, and cited pages analysis.

The [Pro plan](https://www.semrush.com/pricing) starts at $139 per month and includes 5 websites, 500 tracked keywords, and access to the AI Visibility Toolkit. Guru at $249 adds historical data and content optimization tools. Business at $499 includes API access.

Here's the limitation: Semrush focuses primarily on ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. You won't get the multi-LLM coverage of Riff Analytics or Otterly.ai. If your customers use Perplexity or Claude heavily, this isn't the right tool.

**Pros:**

  * Integrated with comprehensive SEO platform
  * AI Visibility Score benchmark (0-100)
  * Familiar interface for existing users
  * Prompt tracking for measuring rankings over time



**Cons:**

  * Limited LLM coverage (ChatGPT + AI Overviews focus)
  * No Perplexity or Claude tracking
  * Requires Semrush subscription (can't buy AI tracking standalone)
  * Most expensive if you only need AI visibility



**Pricing:**

  * Pro: $139/mo (5 websites, 500 keywords)
  * Guru: $249/mo (15 websites, 1,500 keywords, historical data)
  * Business: $499/mo (40 websites, 5,000 keywords, API)
  * Up to 17% discount on annual billing



**Best for:** Existing Semrush users who want to extend their workflow into AI tracking without learning a new platform.

## Key features to prioritize in a ChatGPT visibility tracker

After testing all eight tools, here's what actually matters:

**ChatGPT-focused tracking.** While multi-LLM coverage sounds impressive, most of your audience uses ChatGPT. A tool that tracks ChatGPT deeply beats one that tracks seven platforms shallowly. Decoding's focused approach delivers more actionable insights than platforms spreading themselves thin.

**Actionable optimization suggestions.** Data without guidance is just noise. The best tools (like Decoding and Otterly.ai) tell you exactly what content to create or update to improve visibility, not just where you currently rank.

**Pricing transparency.** Some tools hide pricing behind "contact sales" forms. The best ones show costs upfront. Decoding's $49/mo starting price is clearly displayed with no surprises.

**Whitelabeling for agencies.** If you serve clients, you need reports that look like yours. Decoding and Otterly.ai both offer whitelabel options, but Decoding includes it at a lower price point.

**Ease of use.** You shouldn't need a data science degree to understand your visibility metrics. Decoding's clean interface prioritizes clarity over complexity.

## Getting started with ChatGPT visibility tracking

If you're new to AI visibility tracking, here's a simple process to follow:

  1. **Start with a focused tool.** Decoding offers a 14-day free trial that gives you full access to ChatGPT visibility tracking and optimization suggestions. It's the fastest way to see where you stand.
  2. **Identify your priority prompts.** What questions are your customers asking AI? Focus on 10-20 high-intent prompts related to your category.
  3. **Review your optimization suggestions.** Unlike tools that just show data, Decoding tells you exactly what content to create or update to improve visibility.
  4. **Set up continuous monitoring.** Once you've acted on the initial suggestions, keep tracking weekly to measure improvement and catch new opportunities.
  5. **Scale as needed.** If you need whitelabel reports for clients or want to track multiple brands, upgrade to Decoding's Pro or Agency plans.

## FAQs

### What is ChatGPT visibility?

It’s a measure of how often and how accurately your brand appears in ChatGPT’s responses. It looks at mentions, citations, answer position, sentiment and entity clarity.

### How does ChatGPT choose which brands to mention?

AI models prioritize sources they see as authoritative and up‑to‑date. Factors include the number of quality citations your brand has, the strength of external mentions, structured data, and overall topical depth.

### Will monitoring AI visibility help my SEO?

Yes. Improving your AI visibility often involves building stronger authority signals—like high‑quality content, citations from trusted sites and structured data—which also benefit traditional SEO.

### How is Decoding different from other AI visibility tools?

While many tools provide basic vanity metrics, Decoding offers a blend of deep AI analysis, SEO integration and actionable guidance tailored for small to mid‑size teams. We focus on practical steps to improve your presence, not just reporting.

### Can I track multiple competitors?

Absolutely. In your dashboard you can add your competitors’ domains, compare visibility scores and see which prompts trigger recommendations for each brand.

### Which AI models are covered?

We currently monitor ChatGPT. As new models gain traction, we will expand coverage.

### What is the best ChatGPT visibility tracker?

[Decoding](https://trydecoding.com) is the top choice for agencies thanks to its whitelabeling capabilities, affordable $49/mo starting price, and actionable optimization suggestions you can pass directly to clients. Otterly.ai also offers agency features but at a higher price point ($189/mo for Standard plan).

### What is the best free ChatGPT visibility tracker?

[Wellows](https://wellows.com/tools/chatgpt-visibility-tracker/) offers the best free option with no signup required. You get 40 intent-driven queries and basic citation analysis. For a free trial with full features, Decoding, Riff Analytics, and Otterly.ai all offer 14-day or 7-day trials.

### How does a ChatGPT visibility tracker differ from traditional SEO tools?

Traditional SEO tools track Google rankings, backlinks, and search traffic. ChatGPT visibility trackers monitor brand mentions, citations, and positioning within AI-generated responses across LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude. They answer different questions: SEO tools show how you rank in search results; AI visibility trackers show if AI recommends you in conversations.

### Which ChatGPT visibility tracker has the widest platform coverage?

[Riff Analytics](https://www.riffanalytics.ai) tracks 7 major LLMs, the most of any tool on this list. [GoVISIBLE](https://govisible.ai) monitors 5 engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot). Most other tools cover 3-4 platforms. Decoding focuses specifically on ChatGPT for deeper insights.

### Can I track competitor visibility with these tools?

Yes, all eight tools include competitor tracking. Decoding and Riff Analytics offer particularly strong competitor benchmarking. This helps you understand where competitors appear in AI responses and identify gaps in your own visibility.

### How much should I budget for a ChatGPT visibility tracker?

Budget $29-69 per month for entry-level paid plans (Otterly.ai, Decoding, GoVISIBLE). Mid-tier plans run $97-199 per month. Enterprise solutions with full features typically cost $297-500+ per month. Wellows offers a free tier, and LLM Clicks has lifetime deals starting at $159 one-time.

### Do these tools help improve visibility or just track it?

Most tools focus on tracking and reporting. Decoding stands out by providing specific optimization suggestions: what content to create, what to update, and how to improve your entity signals. Otterly.ai and GoVISIBLE also include GEO audits. However, actually improving visibility requires action: creating authoritative content, earning citations from trusted sources, and building topical authority. Tracking tools identify gaps; execution closes them.

  
Brands that are visible to AI are those who push accurate, structured, and entity-driven content into the ecosystem, today.

## FAQs

### What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

Optimizing your brand to be used and cited by AI answer engines, LLMs, and AI search features (like Google AI Overviews or Google AI Mode).

### What is LLM SEO or LLMO (LLM Optimization)?

Adjusting content and entities so Large Language Models can find, trust, and reference you in their responses.

### What is AI search?

ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and many more are used as an alternative to traditional search engines.

## Search is becoming AI-first

## ChatGPT 5 is the new front page

When buyers ask ChatGPT for "best" or "recommended," the answer is no longer **10 blue links, but a shortlist of brands instead**.

Their answers frame **buyer perception before a click**. If you are not cited, you are not considered. 

We can help you with: 

  * Understand your _LLM Share of voice_ (AI visibility) and avg. ranking for the prompts that convert.
  * Benchmark your competitors to see who ChatGPT recommends instead of you, and why.
  * Get an actionable checklist and insights to lift your visibility where it matters.



## SEO ≠ AEO

SEO focuses on optimizing your own site to rank in search. 

**AEO is about getting your brand mentioned by AI** , which largely depends on how you’re represented across the entire web, **which includes your SEO efforts**.

Call it what you like, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization), or AI Search Optimization, the goal is the same: **be the source that AI trusts, references, and uses to promote.**

Clients expect steady growth, but you’re operating inside an algorithm you don’t control.

Your tool stack is fragmented: audits here, tracking there, reporting somewhere else.

ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews don’t follow traditional ranking logic.

You don’t just need tracking, you need a framework to influence how AI systems surface and cite brands.

## Search is becoming AI-first

### Google integrated AI Overviews & AI Mode in their search results

Gartner predicts that by 2028, brands' organic search traffic will decrease by 50% or more as consumers embrace generative AI-powered search.

### Buyers ask ChatGPT directly for recommendations

According to TrustRadius, 38% of B2B buyers already use AI when evaluating vendors or making purchasing decisions, and vendors estimate that 34% of their customers are doing the same.

### AI-generated answers are converting better than traditional SERP listings

AI search visitors are 4.4 times as valuable as the average visit from traditional organic search, based on conversion rate (Semrush report).
